main_text.p: A. Quorsum itaque indies audiuntur Paftores Ecclefiæ, fi non fint infallibiles?

B. Non id à bono Paftore requiritur, ut non poffit, fed utq nolit fallere, tenentur autem populi eos reverenter r audire, ut ad examen vocatis quæ Christi nomine dicunt omnibus, quod bonum est ampleЯantur & retineant. q2Cor. 4.2. r1Tim. 4.13,15. Mal.2. Act.17.11. 1Thef.5 21. 1Cor. 10.15.

page.notes: The page is partly faded; the Greek-letter reference marks and some italic words ("ampleftantur", "audiuntur") are doubtful. "ampleЯantur" is likely "ampleftantur" (amplectantur). The superscript marks q and r are reference signs. The word "Cap." at the lower right is a printed catchword-like mark and may be a signature instead.
